values.review_scope: Review issue 5832 exact-head semantic envelope, protobuf schema, public catalog, deterministic JSON, compatibility negotiation, Runtime auth and signed-control boundaries, bounded full-duplex WSS, denial/replay/malformed cases, platform evidence, and strict distributed/consumer/Shepherd/cloud non-ownership.
review_prompts: Do protobuf and deterministic JSON preserve exactly one ACIP/A2A semantic identity?
Can catalog or version negotiation drift from the canonical schema or accept incompatible input?
Are auth, signed command, capability, origin, replay, wrong-runtime, limits, and dispatch boundaries enforced before operation execution?
Does real Rustls WSS proof cover bidirectional correlation, backpressure, reconnect, and typed errors on declared platforms?
Did the issue avoid distributed authority, consumer UI, Shepherd behavior, cloud bridge, and custom transport scope?
